column1: # Cells whose answer here is not PostgreSQL 17.11's, for count_distinct_agg_expr_arms_test.go. Every line is a residual:
# every arm answers it alike at the tip (the single arm is the control), and it is wrong at the base b0e0f116 too.
# name<TAB>arms (all | dag | single)<TAB>this engine's answer<TAB>why-code. A kept line that starts answering PostgreSQL FAILS.

#   type: R1 declared type (#1692 second line, not this seam): the two-level DISTINCT rewrite re-aggregates a COUNT (and a SUM over an integer) as SUM over BIGINT partials, which declares numeric; PostgreSQL declares bigint
#   scale: R2 display scale (per-value scale program): AVG over an integer answers 4 or 6 fraction digits where PostgreSQL's numeric has 16
#   intArith: MIN/MAX over an integer plus an integer literal declares bigint where PostgreSQL declares integer; on every arm, with or without the rewrite (the sumDistinct cells too)
#   stddevType: STDDEV over an integer declares double precision where PostgreSQL declares numeric (the values agree to a double's precision); on every arm, with or without the rewrite
#   boolText: the engine's rendering of a boolean is true where PostgreSQL's text format sends t (rendering only, the value agrees)
